body:
![adjustify banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dayyan-Zero/Adjustify/external/adj_banner.png) ## About **Adjustify** is my personal vision for what Minecraft could be. The aim is to get the game feeling like a well-woven tapestry, polished and pleasing to the eye. It's meant to build off of Vanilla and make improvements where needed. Features include things like: improved models (better doors, Re-Creatures are included), longer grass blocks, better slabs, alternate plants and blocks, better Glazed Terracotta, unified workbenches, GUI tweaks, more "human-ish" Villagers and Illagers. ### Supported Version Adjustify only supports Minecraft **1.20.1** at this time. The rapid update cadence and multi-layered levels of technical change brought every several months makes updating extremely time-consuming. Therefore, I've chosen to focus on the version I play the most, which is also the most modern community supported version (for modding and the like). Things may change in the future, but for now, this is the current direction. ## Screenshots ![adjustify screenshots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dayyan-Zero/Adjustify/external/adj_screenshots.png) ## Additional Projects - Better Doors (Coming soon to Adjustify) - Re-Creatures (Coming soon to Adjustify) ## Contributing If you'd like to contribute to the development of Adjustify, visit the project's [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Dayyan-Zero/Adjustify). ## License and Use
